h.en: 5.1.1 Why does an I-beam place material far from its centre?

body.en:
Start with a situation

Two sections can have the same area but different resistance to bending because area distribution about the axis matters.

Definition

Area second moment(moment of inertia of an area)Ix=integral y²dA, Iy=integral x²dA.It is a geometrical property with unitslength⁴.

Understand the reason

Area farther from the chosen axis contributes more because distance is squared. It supports bending/stiffness calculations together with material properties.

Example / application

A vertical rectangle hasIx=bh³/12, so increasing depth is powerful when that is the bending axis.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Area second moment differs from mass moment of inertia(kg·m²) used in rotational dynamics, and from first moment used for centroid.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

બે sectionsનું area સરખું છતાં bending response જુદો હોય,કારણ કે axis વિશે areaનું distribution મહત્વનું છે.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Area second moment(moment of inertia of area) Ix=integral y²dA,Iy=integral x²dA.આ geometrical property છે,units length⁴ છે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Chosen axisથી દૂર area distance squaredને કારણે વધુ ફાળો આપે.Material properties સાથે bending/stiffness calculationsમાં કામ આવે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Vertical rectangleમાં Ix=bh³/12,એટલે એ axis માટે depth વધારવાથી મોટી અસર થાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Area second moment rotational dynamicsના mass moment(kg·m²)થી અને centroidના first momentથી જુદું છે.

h.en: 5.1.2 Section modulus, radius of gyration and polar moment
h.gu: 5.1.2 Section Modulus,Radius of Gyration અને Polar Moment

body.en:
Definition

Elastic section modulus Z=I/c, wherec is distance from the chosen centroidal bending axis to the relevant extreme fibre. Asymmetric sections may have different Z on opposite sides.

Area radius of gyrationk=sqrt(I/A), soI=Ak².Polar area moment about a point J=integral r²dA=Ix+Iy for perpendicular in-plane axes through that point.

Units:I, J mm⁴ or m⁴; Z mm³ or m³; k mm or m.1 mm⁴=10^-12m⁴.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Polar area moment is the circular-shaft torsion property in Unit6; for arbitrary noncircular shapes, the torsion constant is generally not simply J.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Elastic section modulus Z=I/c;અહીં c chosen centroidal bending axisથી relevant extreme fibreનું distance છે.Asymmetric sectionમાં opposite sides પર Z જુદાં હોઈ શકે.

Area radius of gyration k=sqrt(I/A),એટલે I=Ak².Point વિશે polar area moment J=integral r²dA=Ix+Iy,તે pointમાંથી perpendicular in-plane axes માટે.

Units:I,J mm⁴ કે m⁴;Z mm³ કે m³;k mm કે m.1mm⁴=10^-12m⁴.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Unit6ના circular shaftમાં polar area moment torsion property છે;arbitrary noncircular shapesમાં torsion constant સામાન્ય રીતે ફક્ત J નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Parallel-axis theorem:Ireference=Icentroid+Ad², where both axes are parallel andd is perpendicular separation. The centroidal value is the minimum within that family of parallel axes.

Perpendicular-axis theorem for a plane area:Jz=Ix+Iy, where all three axes meet at one point andz is normal to the plane.

Remember / avoid this mistake

InI=Ic+Ad², the component Ic must be about its own centroidal parallel axis; the theorem does not allow arbitrary substitutions of any known I.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Parallel-axis theorem:Ireference=Icentroid+Ad²;બન્ને axes parallel અને d perpendicular separation છે.એ parallel familyમાં centroidal value minimum છે.

Plane area માટે perpendicular-axis theorem:Jz=Ix+Iy;ત્રણેય axes એક point પર મળે,z planeને normal હોય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

I=Ic+Ad²માં component Ic તેના પોતાના centroidal parallel axis વિશે જોઈએ;ગમે તે known I મૂકી ન શકાય.

body.en:
Understand the reason

Rectangleb×h:Ix=bh³/12, Iy=hb³/12. Square sidea:Ix=Iy=a⁴/12. Centred hollow rectangle:Ix=(BH³−bh³)/12, Iy=(HB³−hb³)/12.

Circle diameterd:Ix=Iy=pi d⁴/64, J=pi d⁴/32. Concentric hollow circle:Ix=Iy=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/64, J=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/32.

Triangle baseb, heighth:Ix about base=bh³/12; about centroid parallel to base=bh³/36. For a symmetric isosceles triangle, Iy about symmetry axis=hb³/48.

A hollow triangle needs subtracting inner/outer areas about the same reference axis, including any centroid offsets; do not assume both centroids coincide unless geometry states it.

Remember / avoid this mistake

The cubic dimension is perpendicular to the selected rectangle axis. A hollow-section subtraction requires the inner area at its actual location.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rectangle b×h:Ix=bh³/12,Iy=hb³/12.Square a:Ix=Iy=a⁴/12.Centred hollow rectangle:Ix=(BH³−bh³)/12,Iy=(HB³−hb³)/12.

Circle diameter d:Ix=Iy=pi d⁴/64,J=pi d⁴/32.Concentric hollow circle:Ix=Iy=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/64,J=pi(D⁴−d⁴)/32.

Triangle base b,height h:base વિશે Ix=bh³/12;centroidથી baseને parallel Ix=bh³/36.Symmetric isosceles triangleના symmetry axis વિશે Iy=hb³/48.

Hollow triangleમાં inner/outer areaને same reference axis વિશે subtract કરો,centroid offsets સહિત;geometry ન કહે ત્યાં સુધી centroids coincide માનો નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Rectangle axisને perpendicular dimension cube થાય.Hollow subtractionમાં inner areaનું actual location લો.

body.en:
Given

Rectangleb60 mm, h120 mm; centroidal horizontal axisx.

Stepwise solution

  1. A=7200 mm²; Ix=60×120³/12=8640000 mm⁴
  2. Zx=8640000/60=144000 mm³
  3. kx=sqrt(8640000/7200)=34.6410 mm
  4. I about bottom=Ix+A(60)²=34560000 mm⁴

Remember / avoid this mistake

The extreme fibrec=h/2=60 mm; usingh itself would halve Z incorrectly.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Rectangle b60mm,h120mm;centroidal horizontal axis x.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. A=7200mm²;Ix=60×120³/12=8640000mm⁴
  2. Zx=8640000/60=144000mm³
  3. kx=sqrt(8640000/7200)=34.6410mm
  4. I about bottom=Ix+A(60)²=34560000mm⁴

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Extreme fibre c=h/2=60mm;સીધું h મૂકીએ તો Z ખોટું અડધું થાય.

h.en: 5.1.6 Hollow square and triangle:define the cut-out
h.gu: 5.1.6 Hollow Square અને Triangleમાં Cut-out ઓળખો

body.en:
Given

Centred hollow square outside60 mm, inside40 mm; separate example:outer symmetric triangleb120 mm, h90 mm with an inner triangleb60 mm, h45 mm having the same centroid and parallel base.

Stepwise solution

  1. Hollow square Ix=Iy=(60⁴−40⁴)/12=866666.67 mm⁴
  2. Hollow triangle Ix=(120×90³−60×45³)/36=2278125 mm⁴
  3. Hollow triangle Iy=(90×120³−45×60³)/48=3037500 mm⁴

Remember / avoid this mistake

Triangle subtraction here works without Ad² only because the centroids/axes were explicitly made coincident. An off-centre triangular opening requires its actual offset.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Centred hollow square બહાર60mm,અંદર40mm;અલગ example:outer symmetric triangle b120mm,h90mmમાં inner triangle b60mm,h45mm છે;centroid common,base parallel છે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Hollow square Ix=Iy=(60⁴−40⁴)/12=866666.67mm⁴
  2. Hollow triangle Ix=(120×90³−60×45³)/36=2278125mm⁴
  3. Hollow triangle Iy=(90×120³−45×60³)/48=3037500mm⁴

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

અહીં triangular subtractionમાં Ad² નહિ કારણ કે centroids/axes સ્પષ્ટ coincident આપ્યાં છે.Off-centre triangular openingમાં actual offset જોઈએ.

body.en:
Stepwise solution

  1. Draw dimensions and reference axes; partition into nonoverlapping rectangles or signed cut-outs.
  2. CalculateA, xbar, ybar before centroidal I.
  3. For each piece, formIx i, c+Ai(yi−ybar)² andIy i, c+Ai(xi−xbar)²; sum with the piece sign.
  4. Transfer to another parallel reference axis only after the required centroid/distance is known.

Remember / avoid this mistake

I-section, channel, T, angle and built-up sections follow this same table method. No single bounding rectangle represents the missing area correctly.
body.gu:
એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Dimensions,reference axes દોરી nonoverlapping rectangles કે signed cut-outs લો.
  2. Centroidal I પહેલાં A,xbar,ybar ગણો.
  3. દરેક piece માટે Ix i,c+Ai(yi−ybar)² અને Iy i,c+Ai(xi−xbar)² બનાવી piece sign સાથે ઉમેરો.
  4. જરૂરી centroid/distance મળ્યા પછી જ બીજા parallel reference axis પર transfer કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

I-section,channel,T,angle,built-up sectionમાં આ જ table method છે.એક bounding rectangle missing areaને સાચું દર્શાવતું નથી.

body.en:
Given

Symmetric I:two flanges100×10 mm, clear web10×80 mm, total depth100 mm. Origin bottom-left.

Stepwise solution

  1. A=2800 mm²; ybar=50 mm; xbar=50 mm
  2. Ix=2[100×10³/12+1000(45)²]+10×80³/12=4493333.33 mm⁴
  3. Iy=2[10×100³/12]+80×10³/12=1673333.33 mm⁴
  4. For an asymmetric I with bottom flange120×10, top80×10, clear web10×80 and centred common vertical axis:area stays2800 mm²; bottom centroidy5, web50, top95 mm.
  5. ybar=(1200×5+800×50+800×95)/2800=43.5714 mm
  6. Ix=4377619.05 mm⁴; Iy=1873333.33 mm⁴

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use separate flange dimensions and their actual centroid offsets; asymmetry removes the automatic half-height centroid.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Symmetric I:બે flanges100×10mm,clear web10×80mm,total depth100mm.Origin bottom-left.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. A=2800mm²;ybar=50mm;xbar=50mm
  2. Ix=2[100×10³/12+1000(45)²]+10×80³/12=4493333.33mm⁴
  3. Iy=2[10×100³/12]+80×10³/12=1673333.33mm⁴
  4. Asymmetric Iમાં bottom flange120×10,top80×10,clear web10×80 અને common centred vertical axis હોય તો area2800mm²;bottom centroid y5,web50,top95mm.
  5. ybar=(1200×5+800×50+800×95)/2800=43.5714mm
  6. Ix=4377619.05mm⁴;Iy=1873333.33mm⁴

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Flangesનાં જુદાં dimensions,actual offsets લો;asymmetryમાં centroid આપમેળે half-height નથી.

body.en:
Given

T:bottom web20×80 mm; top flange100×20 mm aty80–100 mm; common symmetry axisx50 mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. A=3600 mm²; ybar=(1600×40+2000×90)/3600=67.7778 mm
  2. Ix=20×80³/12+1600(40−67.7778)²+100×20³/12+2000(90−67.7778)²=3142222.22 mm⁴
  3. Iy=80×20³/12+20×100³/12=1720000 mm⁴
  4. Ztop=Ix/(100−67.7778)=97517.24 mm³; Zbottom=Ix/67.7778=46360.66 mm³

Remember / avoid this mistake

The sameI produces different top/bottom Z because the extreme-fibre distances differ.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

T:bottom web20×80mm;top flange100×20mm,y80–100mm;common symmetry axis x50mm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. A=3600mm²;ybar=(1600×40+2000×90)/3600=67.7778mm
  2. Ix=20×80³/12+1600(40−67.7778)²+100×20³/12+2000(90−67.7778)²=3142222.22mm⁴
  3. Iy=80×20³/12+20×100³/12=1720000mm⁴
  4. Ztop=Ix/(100−67.7778)=97517.24mm³;Zbottom=Ix/67.7778=46360.66mm³

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Extreme-fibre distances જુદાં હોવાથી એ જ Iથી top/bottom Z જુદાં થાય.

body.en:
Given

Channel:bottom/top100×10 mm aty0–10 and90–100; left web10×80 mm aty10–90.

Stepwise solution

  1. A=2800 mm²; xbar=(1000×50+1000×50+800×5)/2800=37.1429 mm; ybar=50 mm
  2. Ix=4493333.33 mm⁴; Iy=2830476.19 mm⁴
  3. Angle made from bottom100×20 and left20×80 above it has centroid(32.2222,32.2222)mm.
  4. Ix=100×20³/12+2000(10−32.2222)²+20×80³/12+1600(60−32.2222)²=3142222.22 mm⁴
  5. Iy=3142222.22 mm⁴

Remember / avoid this mistake

The angle has equal Ix, Iy here due to diagonal symmetry, but the centroidal horizontal/vertical axes need not be principal axes.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Channel:bottom/top100×10mm,y0–10 અને90–100;left web10×80mm,y10–90.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. A=2800mm²;xbar=(1000×50+1000×50+800×5)/2800=37.1429mm;ybar=50mm
  2. Ix=4493333.33mm⁴;Iy=2830476.19mm⁴
  3. Bottom100×20 અને તેના ઉપર left20×80વાળા angleનું centroid(32.2222,32.2222)mm છે.
  4. Ix=100×20³/12+2000(10−32.2222)²+20×80³/12+1600(60−32.2222)²=3142222.22mm⁴
  5. Iy=3142222.22mm⁴

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

અહીં diagonal symmetryથી angleનું Ix,Iy સરખું છે,પણ centroidal horizontal/vertical axes principal હોવા જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Given

Centred hollow rectangle B100, H80, b80, h60 mm; and separately two100×10 mm plates centred aty±40 mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. Hollow Ix=(100×80³−80×60³)/12=2826666.67 mm⁴
  2. Hollow Iy=(80×100³−60×80³)/12=4106666.67 mm⁴
  3. Built-up Ix=2[100×10³/12+1000×40²]=3216666.67 mm⁴

Remember / avoid this mistake

For a structural built-up member, connections must provide the assumed composite action; geometric I alone does not verify joint strength.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Centred hollow rectangle B100,H80,b80,h60mm;અલગ exampleમાં બે100×10mm platesનાં centres y±40mm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Hollow Ix=(100×80³−80×60³)/12=2826666.67mm⁴
  2. Hollow Iy=(80×100³−60×80³)/12=4106666.67mm⁴
  3. Built-up Ix=2[100×10³/12+1000×40²]=3216666.67mm⁴

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Structural built-up memberમાં connections assumed composite action આપે તે જરૂરી;geometric I એકલું joint strength verify નથી કરતું.

h.en: 5.1.12 Exam checks that catch most mistakes

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Label the requested axis; write component A, centroid, distance² andIc; sum signed terms; state unitsmm⁴ and convert only at the end.
  2. CheckIreference≥Icentroid for the same area and parallel axes; check symmetry; for a circle verify J=2I; for a square Ix=Iy.
Quick check: Can a centroidal Ic be used without Ad² when transferring axes?

Only if the axes coincide(d0); otherwise include the shift.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Requested axis label કરો;component A,centroid,distance²,Ic લખો;signed terms ઉમેરો;units mm⁴ આપો,છેલ્લે convert કરો.
  2. Same areaના parallel axesમાં Ireference≥Icentroid જુઓ;symmetry તપાસો;circleમાં J=2I,squareમાં Ix=Iy જુઓ.
જાતે વિચારો: Axes બદલતાં Ad² વગર Ic લઈ શકાય?

Axes coincide(d0) હોય ત્યારે જ;નહિ તો shift ઉમેરો.
